description: Land Acquisition - Udathalawinna, Pathadumbara D/S Division, Kandy District and Thulhiriya, Warakapola D/S Division, Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, specifying particular land parcels with detailed descriptions (boundaries, extents, locations) and authorizing their possession. While it mentions a government minister (Gayantha Karunatilleke), the core subject matter is land-related, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel or structural classification.
